summary: Frontend testing of Production Costing Calculator redesigned tabbed layout. All features working correctly - VP and Regular Production tabs, full-width sections, line items with proper font sizes and spacing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all UI elements and features verified

seed_data_creation: No test data created - frontend-only testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tabbed layout costing calculator fully functional. Redesigned from two-column to full-width tabs. VP tab has Studio/External/Post sections. Regular Production has 5 expandable sections with line items.

tab_switcher.notes: Tab switcher visible with VP (orange) and Regular Production (green) tabs. Clicking switches content correctly.

vp_tab_studio_section.notes: VP Studio section with Per Day Rate, Number of Days, Environment Cost, No. of Environments, Travel Base Cost, MIS Costing fields. Calculations working correctly.

vp_tab_external_party_section.notes: External Party section (collapsible) with 12+ cost fields: Composition/Shot, Number of Shots, DOP, Light Rental, Lens Rental, Hair & Makeup, Art Decor, Art Team, Producer, Stylist, Creative Director, Director, Actor, Logistics.

vp_tab_post_production_section.notes: Post Production section with Sound, Color, Editing fields.

vp_total_breakdown.notes: VP Total shows sum with Studio/External/Post breakdown display.

regular_production_header.notes: Header shows 'REGULAR PRODUCTION BUDGET' title, Shoot Days input (default: 5), Budget Total.

regular_production_sections.notes: 5 expandable sections present - Pre-production (13 items), Production (26 items), Post-production (10 items), Marketing & Distribution (6 items), Legal & Misc (6 items). Color-coded indicators.

line_item_structure.notes: Expanded sections show line items with: Item name (editable), Days indicator, Qty input, Rate input, Subtotal, Remove (×) button.

line_item_font_sizes.notes: Line items use text-sm font sizes and h-9 input heights. Readable and usable - not cramped.

add_line_item_button.notes: + Add line item button visible and functional in each section. Successfully adds new line items.

per_day_vs_fixed_badges.notes: Per-day items show '× N days' badge in green/emerald color. Fixed items show 'Fixed' in gray.

combined_grand_total.notes: Combined Grand Total at bottom always visible. Shows VP and Regular totals. Buttons are clickable to switch tabs.

export_csv_button.notes: Export CSV button works and initiates download.

reset_button.notes: Reset button clears all data. Shows 'Calculator reset' toast notification.

client_details_shared.notes: Client & Quotation Details section (Person Name, Company Name, Email, Revision #, Quotation Date) is shared between tabs - data persists when switching.

full_width_layout.notes: Regular Production sections are full-width (1872px on 1920px viewport). No longer cramped two-column layout.

remove_line_item.notes: Remove (×) button successfully removes line items from sections.

ui_verification.tab_styling: VP tab uses orange (#F9982E) when active, Regular Production uses emerald green when active
ui_verification.section_colors: Regular Production sections have distinct colored indicators (purple, green, blue, red, pink)
ui_verification.typography: Font hierarchy correct - headings uppercase, data values in monospace font
ui_verification.dark_theme: Dark theme with proper contrast throughout
ui_verification.full_width_usage: Sections utilize full viewport width with proper margins
ui_verification.spacing_and_alignment: Proper padding, spacing between rows, columns well-aligned
